aliases: Educational Volunteers Foundation of Turkey volunteering

age_range.verbatim: 15 yaşından büyük, çocuk sevgisiyle dolu kocaman bir kalbiniz varsa siz de TEGV'de gönüllü olabilirsiniz.

prerequisites: Applicants aged 18+ register via the website; applicants under 18 register in person together with a legal guardian. Ages 15–17 are accommodated under 'istisnai gönüllülük' (exceptional volunteering), verbatim: '15-17 yaş gönüllü desteği sağlanabilmektedir' — described as dependent on permission processes ('istisnai gönüllülük kapsamında izin süreçlerine bağlı').
application_window_verbatim: Başvurular her yıl 1 Eylül, 2 Ocak ve 1 Haziran tarihlerinde açılır.
application_open_date: Three intakes per year: 1 September, 2 January, 1 June
cost_note: No participation fee stated; this is unpaid volunteering.
selection_process: Seven-stage onboarding: foundation introduction, application form, information meeting, basic training, document upload, orientation, and programme training (for long-term programmes).
award_or_output: Volunteer roles: Etkinlik Gönüllüsü (activity volunteer, remote or in person), Destek Gönüllüsü (support volunteer), Eğitmen Gönüllü (trainer volunteer), Kurumsal Gönüllülük (corporate volunteering).

sources.title: TEGV — Gönüllü Ol
sources.supports: age floor 15, under-18 in-person registration with guardian, 15–17 exceptional volunteering, three annual intake dates, volunteer types, seven-stage process

research_notes: VERIFIED on the organizer's own page: the 15+ age floor, the under-18 guardian requirement, the 15–17 'exceptional volunteering' route, the three fixed annual intake dates, the volunteer role types, and the seven-stage onboarding. NOT VERIFIED: minimum time commitment, geographic coverage of activity points, and whether the 15–17 route is available in all provinces — the page states it depends on permission processes and quotas ('Kontenjanlar dolunca başvurular kapanabilir'), so availability for a given 15–17 year old is genuinely uncertain and should be surfaced as such to students. High value for ORYN: one of very few structured volunteering routes in Türkiye that explicitly accommodates under-18s. Category 'volunteering' currently has 1 row in ORYN.

age_range.exception: Humanitarian Aid Volunteering is 'open to people up to 35 years old'

prerequisites: Verbatim: 'Young people wishing to engage in projects need to register in the European Solidarity Corps portal'.
cost_note: Verbatim: 'The European Solidarity Corps provides grants to organisations through call for proposals.' Participant cost is NOT stated on the page fetched.
selection_process: Registration in the portal, then application to individual projects run by participating organisations.
award_or_output: Three volunteering routes, verbatim: 'You can volunteer abroad, solo or in a team'; 'You can set up your own project in your community'; 'Humanitarian Aid Volunteering'.
source_title: European Solidarity Corps — European Youth Portal

sources.title: European Solidarity Corps — European Youth Portal
sources.supports: age range 18–30, humanitarian aid exception to 35, three volunteering routes, grants-to-organisations funding model, portal registration requirement

research_notes: VERIFIED: age range, the humanitarian-aid age exception, the three activity routes, the grants-to-organisations funding model, and the portal registration requirement — all quoted from the official EU youth portal. NOT VERIFIED: the list of eligible countries (the page links to 'Countries covered' but does not enumerate them), participant out-of-pocket cost, and any deadline (projects have rolling, organisation-set timelines). AGE CAVEAT FOR ORYN: the 18 floor puts this out of reach for most of ORYN's 14–18 audience — it is only actionable for final-year/just-graduated students. It is recorded because the volunteering category has 1 row and because it is the single largest structured youth volunteering scheme in Europe, but the product must not surface it to a 15-year-old as actionable. Recommend ingestion stores minimum_age=18 strictly.
